verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-aligned stack (logo, headline, subline, CTA) with clear hierarchy, but it drops the sea photo entirely, which costs fidelity. The subline also runs almost to the right edge, and the headline breaks awkwardly, leaving '$89' on its own line. B squeezes the photo into a thin top strip, where the white logo sits on pale sky and is nearly invisible. It also leaves a large empty blue gap in the middle and crams all the copy against the bottom. The CTA is centred while the text above it is left-aligned, and the subline nearly touches both side edges.
